'''Samuel Wong Ping-wai''', [[Order of the British Empire|MBE]], [[Justice of the peace|JP]] (2 November 1937, Hong Kong&nbsp;– 4 June 1997, Hong Kong) was a member of the [[Legislative Council of Hong Kong]] (1991–97) and also the [[Urban Council of Hong Kong]].<ref>{{cite book|title=Read Their Lips (I): A dossier of political leaders in Hong Kong|publisher=Pace Publishing Ltd|page=330}}</ref>

==His Death and His Family==
Samuel Wong died of a heart attack on 4 June 1997 in Hong Kong. At that time, he had three children: Andrew Wong, Adrian Wong and a daughter. His 2 grandchildren were born later in 2008 and 2009. Samuel was buried at a local graveyard in Chai Wan, Hong Kong.
